rows.what_the_ink_shows: The insertion says une extension de $\operatorname{Pic}(A)$ par, with no plus sign on Pic (crops/15_scan159_L179_class_group.jpg). The first quotient is $\uuline{A}^{*}(\widehat{\mathbf Z})/E^0$; the hat over Z is visible and there is no closure bar over the denominator (crops/15_scan159_L179_first_kernel.jpg). The second expression contains the real factor and division by $\uuline A^*(\mathbf Z)$ (crops/15_scan159_L179_second_formula.jpg), followed by division by the connected component (crops/15_scan159_L179_connected_component.jpg). The left margin reads vérifier ce pt. (crops/15_scan159_L179_verification_note.jpg).
rows.note: Preserve the written extension of $\operatorname{Pic}(A)$ by $\uuline A^*(\widehat{\mathbf Z})/E^0$ and its second formulation. The row proposes an extension of the narrow class group $\operatorname{Pic}^{+}(A)$ by $\widehat{\mathcal O}^{*}/\overline{E^0}$, or of the ordinary class group by $(\widehat{\mathcal O}^{*}\times\pi_0(K_{\mathbb R}^{*}))/\overline E$. Those are mathematical corrections involving real-place signs and closure, not alternative readings of the ink. The supplied row attributes the same correction to Michel Hua, but its quoted evidence is truncated; no missing quotation is reconstructed. Neither that external project nor an independent class-field-theory proof was consulted. The author’s existing verification note is retained.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Compared the assigned source and row with the full-page scan, then inspected separate enlarged contrast-raised crops of the inserted class-group name, first quotient, second expression, connected-component phrase, and author’s marginal verification note. Confirmed ordinary Pic(A), unbarred E^0, and the retained alternative formulation. No independent mathematical check was performed.

main_reader_review: Inspected all five crops. Confirmed ordinary Pic(A), the hatted Z quotient by unbarred E^0, the second expression and connected-component wording, and the author verification note. Accepted b: the narrow-class-group and closure proposals are mathematical refinements, not changes justified by the ink.
